# Module `lune_ui_core::widgets::panel`

[API reference](../../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core::widgets`](../widgets.md)

The panel (`layout.panel`, D148): an outlined group box with a title and a meta line, a body in
one of five kinds and an optional action footer.

[`Ui::panel`](../ui.md#method.Ui.panel) draws no fill, only the 1 px `border_subtle` outline at radius 8, and does it last
so nothing the body drew covers it. `content` is called for the body and then the footer, in tab
order, and returns the body's height.

- `fit: true` hugs the body and returns the panel's height; `fit: false` fills the rect with the
  footer pinned to its bottom, which is how panels in a row share a bottom edge.
- An empty header (no title, no meta) and an empty footer (no note, no footer buttons) take no
  height. A kind with no header gets a top padding of its own (see [`PanelKind`](panel.md#enum.PanelKind)).
- `unavailable` replaces the body with one `fg_tertiary` line (node `Status`, polite); the body
  slot is not called. The footer stays.

Text cannot be cut by a rounded clip (D12), so the toolkit keeps its own text at least the
radius from the edges (16 for the header, the note and the unavailable line). The body is
clipped to the rounded rect, which cuts fills and images; a flush body's text is the caller's
to keep [`TEXT_INSET`](panel.md#constant.TEXT_INSET) in. With `fit: true` the final height is known only after the body ran,
so the clip takes the height the last frame ended with (the rect given on the first frame); a
frame whose height differs from the clip it used asks for one catch-up frame.

## Enums

<a id="enum.PanelKind"></a>
### Enum `PanelKind`

```rust
pub enum PanelKind {
    Plain,
    Rows,
    Flush,
    Strip,
    Card,
}
```

How the body is padded and what edges it has.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/panel.rs:53`

**Variants**

- <a id="variant.PanelKind.Plain"></a>`Plain`

  Body padding 0 16 16; 16 above when there is no header.

- <a id="variant.PanelKind.Rows"></a>`Rows`

  Rows of a list: padding 0 4 8; 8 above when there is no header.

- <a id="variant.PanelKind.Flush"></a>`Flush`

  A table or list edge to edge, with a hairline under the header. No padding.

- <a id="variant.PanelKind.Strip"></a>`Strip`

  A row of [`Ui::stat_strip`](../ui.md#method.Ui.stat_strip) cells, whose hairlines divide it. No padding.

- <a id="variant.PanelKind.Card"></a>`Card`

  A panel inside a panel: padding 12 all round, and the footer's buttons sit 12 from the
  bottom and right with no hairline above them.

<a id="enum.PanelSlot"></a>
### Enum `PanelSlot`

```rust
pub enum PanelSlot {
    Body(Rect),
    Footer(Rect),
}
```

The slot a [`Ui::panel`](../ui.md#method.Ui.panel) closure is called for.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/widgets/panel.rs:102`

**Variants**

- <a id="variant.PanelSlot.Body"></a>`Body(Rect)`

  The body's padded box; the closure returns the content's height. Its height is the room
  left in the rect.

- <a id="variant.PanelSlot.Footer"></a>`Footer(Rect)`

  The footer's buttons: [`BUTTON_ROW`](panel.md#constant.BUTTON_ROW) high, `footer_w` wide, at the right. Called only when
  `footer_w` is above 0.
